# INTERVAL values are supported only where the emulator implements them; anything else, such as
# arithmetic, is unsupported rather than left to DuckDB.

SELECT MAKE_INTERVAL(day => 7) * 2
=> error contains: The emulator does not support function $MULTIPLY with INTERVAL

SELECT STRUCT(MAKE_INTERVAL(day => 7) AS i) IS DISTINCT FROM STRUCT(MAKE_INTERVAL(hour => 168) AS i)
=> error contains: The emulator does not support function $IS_DISTINCT_FROM with INTERVAL

SELECT CAST(STRUCT(MAKE_INTERVAL(day => 7) AS i) AS JSON)
=> error contains: The emulator does not support CAST from STRUCT<i INTERVAL> to JSON

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING([MAKE_INTERVAL(day => 7)])
=> error contains: The emulator does not support function TO_JSON_STRING with INTERVAL

SELECT EXTRACT(WEEK FROM MAKE_INTERVAL(day => 7))
=> error contains: The emulator does not support function $EXTRACT

SELECT EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM MAKE_INTERVAL(month => 3))
=> error contains: The emulator does not support function $EXTRACT

SELECT ARRAY_AGG(i) FROM UNNEST([MAKE_INTERVAL(day => 7)]) AS i
=> error contains: The emulator does not support aggregate or analytic function ARRAY_AGG with INTERVAL

SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY STRUCT(i)) FROM UNNEST([MAKE_INTERVAL(day => 7)]) AS i
=> error contains: The emulator does not support PARTITION BY with INTERVAL

SELECT MAKE_INTERVAL(day => 7) INTERSECT ALL SELECT MAKE_INTERVAL(day => 8)
=> error contains: The emulator does not support set operation with INTERVAL
